answer_1.quote: We introduce WildScore, the first in-the-wild symbolic music reasoning benchmark, grounded in real music scores and authentic expert questions.

answer_2.quote: Following standard practice in multimodal reasoning benchmarks , we adopt accuracy as our primary metric, calculated as the percentage of correctly answered multiple-choice questions.

answer_3.quote: In the event of a tie, we used a language-model judge (Appendix A) to select the response best grounded in the question context.

answer_4.quote: A Level-5 human expert was evaluated on 100 proportionally sampled questions spanning easy, medium, and hard categories, achieving an overall average accuracy of 72%.
answer_4.guideline: proportionally sampled questions spanning easy, medium, and hard categories
